Noctua · Settings

Server & connection

Your library and AI tasks live on the connected server. Closing Noctua leaves the server and its tasks running.

Where do you want to work?

AI CLIs, API keys, Zotero paths and data folders belong to the server computer. Local AI setup is unnecessary for a remote connection.

No active connection.

Choose a connection to begin.

Server details

Switching checks every open tab for unsaved notes, files, PDF comments and chat drafts. Failed saves keep the current connection. Tasks stay on their original server.





This computer’s server
These controls manage this computer, even when you connect to a remote server. Switching connections leaves the local server running.







Login auto-start is separate from starting a background server. Turning it off leaves the current server running.






Desktop





Desktop updates leave the server running. Restart the server explicitly after its tasks finish to use the updated executable.
